=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
# TOPOLOGY: jq

## story architecture-foundation
summary: Establish the standalone Python interpreter architecture and executable boundary.
type: foundational
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: ARCHITECTURE.md
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: jq interpreter architecture
consumes:
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Establish the module boundaries for lexing, parsing, generator evaluation, builtins, runtime errors, and CLI serialization. Keep the implementation standard-library-only and prevent shelling out to any jq implementation.

## story EXEC-001
summary: Implement the executable jq entry point.
type: foundational
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Executable-Entry-Point.md
covers: EXEC-001
context: sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: ./jq -c program interface
consumes: jq interpreter architecture
depends: architecture-foundation
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Deliver an executable named jq at the application root. Accept the exercised -c program interface, read JSON from standard input, evaluate the program, and emit compact JSON values one per line.

## story EXEC-002
summary: Implement jq process exit and diagnostic behavior.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Process-Contract.md
covers: EXEC-002
context: sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: compile and runtime exit contract
consumes: ./jq -c program interface
depends: EXEC-001
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Distinguish compile failures with exit 3, runtime failures with exit 5, and successful completion with exit 0. Send diagnostics only to stderr and preserve output emitted before a runtime failure.

## story EXEC-003
summary: Implement JSON input and compact output handling.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-JSON-I-O.md
covers: EXEC-003
context: sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: JSON input stream and compact JSON output
consumes: compile and runtime exit contract
depends: EXEC-002
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Parse multiple JSON input values, preserve Unicode and special numeric behavior required by the corpus, and serialize every produced value as one compact JSON value per line.

## story PARSE-001
summary: Implement jq lexical scanning.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Lexer.md
covers: PARSE-001
context: sources/lexer.l, sources/parser.y
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: jq tokenization
consumes: JSON input stream and compact JSON output
depends: EXEC-003
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement identifiers, fields, bindings, keywords, literals, operators, delimiters, comments, formats, and lexical rejection behavior according to the supplied lexer reference.

## story PARSE-002
summary: Implement literals, strings, escapes, and interpolation.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Literals-and-Strings.md
covers: PARSE-002
context: sources/lexer.l, sources/parser.y, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: jq string and literal expressions
consumes: jq tokenization
depends: PARSE-001
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Parse JSON escapes, Unicode strings, formatted strings, and \(expression) interpolation, including invalid escape rejection.

## story PARSE-003
summary: Implement the core jq filter expression grammar.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Filter-Grammar.md
covers: PARSE-003
context: sources/parser.y, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: jq filter AST
consumes: jq string and literal expressions
depends: PARSE-002
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement precedence and parsing for pipes, commas, indexing, slicing, arrays, objects, unary operators, binary operators, parentheses, and optional expressions.

## story PARSE-004
summary: Implement declarations, control syntax, and grammar rejection.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Advanced-Grammar.md
covers: PARSE-004
context: sources/parser.y, sources/lexer.l, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: declarations and control-flow AST forms
consumes: jq filter AST
depends: PARSE-003
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Parse definitions, imports and modules, conditionals, try/catch, reductions, foreach, labels, bindings, and destructuring. Reject invalid module grammar and other %%FAIL programs with compile exit 3 without loading module fixtures.

## story CORE-001
summary: Implement stream-valued filter evaluation.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Generator-Core.md
covers: CORE-001
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: ordered jq generator evaluation
consumes: jq filter AST
depends: PARSE-004
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Evaluate filters as ordered streams with zero, one, or many outputs, preserving backtracking, multiplicity, and generator ordering.

## story CORE-002
summary: Implement composition and cartesian evaluation.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Composition.md
covers: CORE-002
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: pipe, comma, collection, object, and cartesian semantics
consumes: ordered jq generator evaluation
depends: CORE-001
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement composition of streams, cartesian products for filter arguments, array collection, object construction, and multi-output operator behavior.

## story CORE-003
summary: Implement empty, runtime errors, optional evaluation, and partial output.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Errors-and-Optional.md
covers: CORE-003
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: empty, error, try, catch, and optional semantics
consumes: ordered jq generator evaluation
depends: CORE-002, EXEC-002
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement empty streams, runtime errors, try/catch, the ? operator, and preservation of outputs emitted before a runtime error.

## story CORE-004
summary: Implement truthiness, equality, and ordering semantics.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Truthiness-and-Comparison.md
covers: CORE-004
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: jq truthiness and comparison
consumes: ordered jq generator evaluation
depends: CORE-002
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Treat only false and null as falsey and implement structural equality, numeric equivalence, and jq type ordering.

## story VALUE-001
summary: Implement the jq value model and numeric edge cases.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Value-Model.md
covers: VALUE-001
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: jq JSON values, NaN, and infinities
consumes: JSON input stream and compact JSON output
depends: EXEC-003, CORE-004
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Represent null, booleans, numbers, strings, arrays, objects, NaN, and infinities with the numeric conversion and serialization behavior required by the corpus.

## story VALUE-002
summary: Implement field and index access.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Accessors.md
covers: VALUE-002
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/parser.y
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: field, index, optional, and negative-index access
consumes: jq value model and ordered jq generator evaluation
depends: VALUE-001, CORE-001
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement object fields, array indices, dynamic keys, optional access, missing values, and negative indices with jq error behavior.

## story VALUE-003
summary: Implement slices and collection iteration.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Slices-and-Iteration.md
covers: VALUE-003
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: array/string slices and array/object iteration
consumes: field, index, optional, and negative-index access
depends: VALUE-002
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement array and string slices, iteration over arrays and objects, optional iteration, fractional bounds, and out-of-range behavior.

## story VALUE-004
summary: Implement type, length, numeric predicates, and math primitives.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Type-and-Numeric-Primitives.md
covers: VALUE-004
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: type and numeric builtin filters
consumes: jq value model
depends: VALUE-001, CORE-004
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement type, length, utf8bytelength, numeric predicates, conversion functions, arithmetic primitives, and required standard-library math functions.

## story FLOW-001
summary: Implement arithmetic and structural operators.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Arithmetic-and-Structural-Operators.md
covers: FLOW-001
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: jq arithmetic and structural operators
consumes: jq value model and comparison semantics
depends: VALUE-004, CORE-002
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement +, -, *, /, %, unary negation, recursive object merge, string repetition, and string splitting with jq type errors and numeric behavior.

## story FLOW-002
summary: Implement boolean and alternative operators.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Boolean-and-Alternative-Operators.md
covers: FLOW-002
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: and, or, not, //, and //=
consumes: jq truthiness and comparison
depends: CORE-004, CORE-003
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement boolean operators, not, defined-or fallback, short-circuiting, and defined-or assignment while preserving generator semantics.

## story FLOW-003
summary: Implement conditionals and exception flow.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Conditionals-and-Exception-Flow.md
covers: FLOW-003
context: sources/parser.y, sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: if, elif, else, try, catch, and optional control flow
consumes: empty, error, try, catch, and optional semantics
depends: CORE-003, FLOW-002
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement branch streams, optional else behavior, try/catch propagation, and optional operators across nested control flow.

## story FLOW-004
summary: Implement lexical labels and breaks.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Labels-and-Breaks.md
covers: FLOW-004
context: sources/parser.y, sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: label and break control
consumes: conditionals and exception flow
depends: FLOW-003
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement lexically scoped labels and breaks that terminate only the corresponding generator and reject unbound breaks at compile time.

## story FLOW-005
summary: Implement reductions and iteration-control builtins.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Reductions-and-Iteration-Control.md
covers: FLOW-005
context: sources/parser.y, sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: reduce, foreach, range, limit, skip, first, last, and nth
consumes: labels and breaks, ordered jq generators
depends: FLOW-004, CORE-001
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement stateful reductions, foreach extraction, ranges, limiting, skipping, first/last/nth, cartesian arguments, and backtracking.

## story FLOW-006
summary: Implement recursive generators.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Recursive-Generators.md
covers: FLOW-006
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: while, until, repeat, recurse, and recursive descent
consumes: ordered jq generator evaluation and conditionals
depends: FLOW-005, FLOW-003
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement while, until, repeat, recurse, recursive descent, and safe termination behavior for recursive generator expressions.

## story FUNC-001
summary: Implement lexical variable bindings.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Variable-Bindings.md
covers: FUNC-001
context: sources/parser.y, sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: as bindings, variables, shadowing, and patterns
consumes: jq filter AST and ordered jq generators
depends: PARSE-004, CORE-001
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement as bindings, nested lexical scope, shadowing, keyword identifiers, destructuring patterns, and value lifetime.

## story FUNC-002
summary: Implement filter and value function parameters.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Function-Parameters.md
covers: FUNC-002
context: sources/parser.y, sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/builtin.jq, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: filter and value function arguments
consumes: lexical variable bindings and generator evaluation
depends: FUNC-001, CORE-002
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement user-defined functions with filter parameters, value parameters, multiple arities, closures, and cartesian argument evaluation.

## story FUNC-003
summary: Implement function definitions, scope, redefinition, and recursion.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Function-Definitions.md
covers: FUNC-003
context: sources/parser.y, sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: lexical function definitions and recursion
consumes: filter and value function arguments
depends: FUNC-002
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement definitions, forward and self references, lexical function scope, redefinitions by arity, and recursive user functions.

## story FUNC-004
summary: Implement destructuring alternatives.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Destructuring-Alternatives.md
covers: FUNC-004
context: sources/parser.y, sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: ?// destructuring alternatives
consumes: lexical variable bindings and exception flow
depends: FUNC-001, FLOW-003
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement array and object destructuring, missing bindings, ?// alternatives, fallback binding behavior, and error-triggered alternative selection.

## story PATH-001
summary: Implement path discovery and projection.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Path-Discovery.md
covers: PATH-001
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: path, paths, and pick
consumes: accessors, slices, and recursive generators
depends: VALUE-003, FLOW-006
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement exact and generated paths, path filtering, paths, and projections with valid path arrays and path-expression errors.

## story PATH-002
summary: Implement path access and mutation primitives.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Path-Primitives.md
covers: PATH-002
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: getpath, setpath, and delpaths
consumes: path discovery and jq value model
depends: PATH-001, VALUE-002
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement nested path reads, creation and replacement, deletion, array expansion, invalid-path errors, depth limits, and immutable updates.

## story PATH-003
summary: Implement deletion and assignment operators.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Assignment-Operators.md
covers: PATH-003
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test, sources/builtin.jq
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: del, =, |=, +=, -=, *=, /=, %=, and //=
consumes: getpath, setpath, and delpaths
depends: PATH-002, FLOW-002
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement deletion, plain assignment, update assignment, arithmetic assignment, defined-or assignment, multiple paths, and immutable output behavior.

## story PATH-004
summary: Implement complex assignment edge cases.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Complex-Assignments.md
covers: PATH-004
context: sources/jq.test, sources/jq-manual.txt
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: complex assignment edge-case behavior
consumes: deletion and assignment operators
depends: PATH-003, FLOW-005
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Handle iterated paths, empty updates, array expansion, invalid paths, negative and NaN indices, deep paths, and partial assignment failures.

## story DATA-001
summary: Implement collection transformation builtins.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Collection-Transformations.md
covers: DATA-001
context: sources/builtin.jq, sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: map, map_values, select, add, flatten, transpose, combinations, and walk
consumes: generator evaluation and assignment
depends: CORE-002, PATH-003, FLOW-006
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement collection transformations and recursive walk semantics, including empty streams and bounded flattening.

## story DATA-002
summary: Implement sorting, grouping, and extrema builtins.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Sorting-and-Grouping.md
covers: DATA-002
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/builtin.jq, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: sort, sort_by, group_by, unique, unique_by, min, max, min_by, and max_by
consumes: jq comparison and generator semantics
depends: CORE-004, DATA-001
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement jq ordering, keyed sorting, grouping, uniqueness, minima, maxima, and deep comparison limits.

## story DATA-003
summary: Implement object-entry and containment builtins.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Object-Entries-and-Containment.md
covers: DATA-003
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/builtin.jq, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: keys, keys_unsorted, has, in, inside, contains, to_entries, from_entries, and with_entries
consumes: jq value model and comparison semantics
depends: VALUE-002, CORE-004, DATA-001
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement object and array key utilities, containment and inverse containment, entry conversion, and entry transformations.

## story DATA-004
summary: Implement index, membership, search, and SQL-style utilities.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Index-and-Membership.md
covers: DATA-004
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/builtin.jq, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: indices, index, rindex, bsearch, all, any, isempty, INDEX, JOIN, and IN
consumes: collection transformations and comparison semantics
depends: DATA-002, DATA-003, FLOW-005
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement array and string search, binary search, quantifiers, emptiness checks, and SQL-style index, join, and membership functions.

## story TEXT-001
summary: Implement string manipulation builtins.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-String-Manipulation.md
covers: TEXT-001
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/builtin.jq, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: trimming, case, codepoint, split, join, prefix, and suffix filters
consumes: jq string and value primitives
depends: VALUE-004, FLOW-001
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement trimming, prefix and suffix operations, ASCII case conversion, explode and implode, split, join, and interpolation-related string behavior.

## story TEXT-002
summary: Implement JSON conversion and output formats.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Formats-and-Serialization.md
covers: TEXT-002
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: tostring, tojson, fromjson, @text, @json, @html, @uri, @urid, @csv, @tsv, @sh, @base64, and @base64d
consumes: jq value model and string manipulation
depends: TEXT-001, VALUE-001
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement JSON conversion and all required format filters with escaping, encoding, decoding, interpolation, and compact serialization semantics.

## story TEXT-003
summary: Implement regular-expression filters.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Regular-Expressions.md
covers: TEXT-003
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/builtin.jq, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: test, match, capture, scan, split, splits, sub, and gsub
consumes: jq string manipulation and generator evaluation
depends: TEXT-001, CORE-001
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement regular-expression matching, flags, named captures, offsets, streams, splitting, substitution, and global substitution using the Python standard library.

## story TEXT-004
summary: Implement date and time filters.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Date-and-Time.md
covers: TEXT-004
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/builtin.jq, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: strptime, strftime, strflocaltime, gmtime, localtime, mktime, fromdate, and todate
consumes: jq string and numeric primitives
depends: VALUE-004, TEXT-001
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement UTC ISO dates, low-level broken-down time conversion, formatting, parsing, and the supplied timezone behavior.

## story IO-001
summary: Implement input stream controls.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Input-Controls.md
covers: IO-001
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: input, inputs, input_filename, and input_line_number
consumes: JSON input stream and generator evaluation
depends: EXEC-003, CORE-001
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement input stream consumption and input metadata within the fixed stdin interface, preserving interaction with ordinary filter input.

## story IO-002
summary: Implement diagnostics and stderr filters.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Diagnostics.md
covers: IO-002
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: debug, stderr, and halt_error
consumes: process exit and diagnostic behavior
depends: EXEC-002, CORE-003
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement debug and stderr side effects, raw stderr output, halt_error exit behavior, and preservation of stdout semantics.

## story IO-003
summary: Implement streaming transformations.
type: service
kind: capability
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Streaming.md
covers: IO-003
context: sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/builtin.jq, sources/jq.test
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: tostream, fromstream, and truncate_stream
consumes: input controls and generator evaluation
depends: IO-001, CORE-001
acceptance: yes
scope: target
instructions: |
  Implement jq stream-form conversion, reconstruction, and path truncation for the supplied streaming cases.

## story CONF-001
summary: Stage and validate immutable conformance assets.
type: foundational
kind: test harness
phase: 1
implements: FEATURE-Conformance-Assets.md
covers: CONF-001
context: sources/INSTRUCTIONS.md, sources/run_conformance.py, sources/jq.test, sources/exclusions.txt, sources/full_test.sh, sources/jq-manual.txt, sources/parser.y, sources/lexer.l, sources/builtin.jq
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: staged conformance corpus and harness
consumes: jq interpreter architecture
depends: architecture-foundation
acceptance: yes
scope: both
instructions: |
  Stage all supplied sources unchanged in the required sources directory. Validate corpus parsing, exclusion consistency, and the expected complete asset set by importing the harness parsers directly. Do not launch the candidate or alter any source asset.

## story CONF-002
summary: Provide scoped conformance verification for implementation slices.
type: service
kind: test harness
phase: 2
implements: FEATURE-Scoped-Conformance.md
covers: CONF-002
context: sources/run_conformance.py, sources/jq.test, sources/exclusions.txt
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: scoped conformance verification
consumes: staged conformance corpus and harness, ./jq -c program interface
depends: CONF-001, EXEC-001
acceptance: yes
scope: both
instructions: |
  Bind scoped acceptance checks to the supplied conformance runner with JQ supplied through the inherited environment. Each implementing slice must execute matching cases and assert the parsed report has no failures or errors and matched a non-empty case set.

## story CONF-003
summary: Verify the completed interpreter against the full conformance corpus.
type: feature
kind: test harness
phase: 3
implements: FEATURE-Full-Conformance.md
covers: CONF-003
accepts: st-001
context: sources/full_test.sh, sources/run_conformance.py, sources/jq.test, sources/exclusions.txt
stack: common.md, python.md
provides: complete jq conformance verification
consumes: scoped conformance verification
depends: EXEC-001, EXEC-002, EXEC-003, PARSE-001, PARSE-002, PARSE-003, PARSE-004, CORE-001, CORE-002, CORE-003, CORE-004, VALUE-001, VALUE-002, VALUE-003, VALUE-004, FLOW-001, FLOW-002, FLOW-003, FLOW-004, FLOW-005, FLOW-006, FUNC-001, FUNC-002, FUNC-003, FUNC-004, PATH-001, PATH-002, PATH-003, PATH-004, DATA-001, DATA-002, DATA-003, DATA-004, TEXT-001, TEXT-002, TEXT-003, TEXT-004, IO-001, IO-002, IO-003, CONF-001, CONF-002
acceptance: yes
scope: both
instructions: |
  Assemble the completed interpreter and run the supplied full scoring entry point from the application root. This is the terminal verification story and its full-suite acceptance must require the command to exit successfully.
